name: l2cap_disconnect_handler

ownership.argument: Bluelet owner-only handler paired with the public disconnect wrapper. Disconnect request payload carries the cid at +0.

provenance.source: Submitted by bt_l2cap_disconnect 0xC805B38. Takes the cid from request+0, walks the channel list at *(*(owner)) comparing channel+116, requires the state byte at channel+120 to be 2, then resets the channel field group (+33 byte, +36/+40/+44 = -1, +48 word, +52 halfword, +64 byte) and frees the request node with bt_free.

notes: Bluelet owner-only handler paired with the public disconnect wrapper. Disconnect request payload carries the cid at +0.
